The time when unit became active or started is printed after the "@" character.
The time the unit took to start is printed after the "+" character.

graphical.target @22.400s
`-multi-user.target @22.390s
  `-gdm.service @22.000s +390ms
    `-basic.target @21.950s
      `-dbus.socket @21.920s +25ms
        `-sysinit.target @21.850s
          `-systemd-journald.service @21.550s +300ms
            `-local-fs.target @21.200s
              `-custom-agent.service @5.200s +16.000s
                `-sys-devices-virtual.device @5.000s +200ms
